steps.where: R26 / T21 Build the test app r1
steps.text: 1. Open the code file: press Windows key + R, press Ctrl+V (the file path is on the clipboard), then Enter. Keep Notepad open.

steps.where: R26 / T21 Build the test app r1
steps.text: 3. Select Create > Blank app > Blank canvas app. Name: 90161Z T21 Probe r1. Format: Tablet. Select Create.

steps.where: R26 / T21 Build the test app r1
steps.text: 4. On the left select Data > Add data > SharePoint. Paste the test site address, tick "90161Z Probe" and "90161Z Probe Files", select Connect.

steps.where: R26 / T21 Build the test app r1
steps.text: 5. Select Add data again, type Office 365 Users, and select it.

steps.where: R26 / T21 Build the test app r1
steps.text: 7. Select Insert > Edit form. Data source: "90161Z Probe". Keep the fields Title and Attachments. Drag the form to the lower right.

steps.where: R26 / T21 Build the test app r1
steps.text: 8. In Tree view, double-click the name of the form and type: frmProbe

steps.where: R26 / T21 Build the test app r1
steps.text: 9. Set the form as the part "BY HAND for block 6" in the file says, items 4 to 6 (3 short formulas).
fails: points elsewhere (names a step, block, item or part: "part "..."")

steps.where: R26 / T21 Build the test app r1
steps.text: 10. In Notepad, copy block 1 (the lines between its 2 marker lines). In Tree view, right-click Screen1 and select Paste code.
fails: points elsewhere (names a step, block, item or part: "block 1")

steps.where: R26 / T21 Build the test app r1
steps.text: 11. Do step 10 again for blocks 2 to 6. If a block is refused: use the part "BY HAND" under that block in the file, then go on.
fails: points elsewhere (names a step, block, item or part: "step 10")

steps.where: R26 / T21 Build the test app r1
steps.text: 12. Select Save (Ctrl+S), then Publish > Publish this version.

steps.where: R26 / T21 Build the test app r1
steps.text: 13. Return to RADE, select "Done: app built" and answer the 2 questions.

steps.where: R26 / T21 Second person r1
steps.text: 1. In Power Apps select Apps, select the three dots beside "90161Z T21 Probe r1", then Share.

steps.where: R26 / T21 Second person r1
steps.text: 2. Add the second person as User (not Co-owner), select Share, and send that person the app link (Details > Web link).

steps.where: R26 / T21 Second person r1
steps.text: 3. The person opens the link, selects Allow if asked, then selects the button "T4 a" and then the button "T4 b, T7 b, T8".

steps.where: R26 / T21 Second person r1
steps.text: 5. Return to RADE, select "Done: second person" and answer the question.
